hook: 4 dates *HVAC* owners can't let lapse before the winter rush
title: 4 dates *HVAC* owners can't let lapse before the winter rush

items.title: Contractor license
items.body: Renews on its own schedule. Some states want CE hours done first.

items.title: Liability insurance + COI
items.body: Property managers and GCs often want a current one before you start.

items.title: Workers' comp
items.body: Hiring extra techs for the cold snap? Make sure coverage keeps up.

items.title: Van registrations
items.body: Every truck in the fleet, each on its own date.
